title: Telegram alert bodies: readable, formatted, no extraneous prose
shipping_definition: telegram_formatter/alert.py build_alert_message emits a 4-6 line body with Markdown (bold + emoji), no 'Classification:' / 'YOLO:' / 'Vision:' labels
telegram_formatter/detail.py build_detail_message emits a curated attribute list (clothing, colors, make, model) instead of recursive VM2 dict dump
telegram_formatter/match_alert.py build_match_message strips 'Thresholds:' / 'Mode:' debug lines; match body shows label/make/model/owner only
telegram_formatter/dispatcher.py _send_message/_send_photo/_send_media_group pass parse_mode=MarkdownV2 and emoji/bold render correctly in TG
telegram_formatter/no_match_telegram.py keeps essentials but strips the 12-line key:value dump; emits 'No match (confidence <X>)' single line
All bodies include the 'TG X of 3' marker (operator requirement: alerts come out of order and user wants flow position)
tests/test_alert_message.py + tests/test_match_alert.py + tests/test_detail_message.py cover the new shape; pytest passes
No fallback to old format. parse_mode=MarkdownV2 is the only path.
design_principles: TG X of 3 marker on every body (operator requirement: alerts arrive out of order; user wants flow position)
Bold class/label via *bold* Markdown; emoji icons (🎥 Camera, 👤 Person, 🚗 Vehicle, 🐕 Animal, ✅ Match, ⚠️ Unsure)
Header line '🎥 *Front Door Outside* — 12:21 PM' replaces 'Camera:' / 'Timestamp:' two-line preamble
alert_id shortened to first 8 chars ('72c70d5f') so it fits but stays useful for debugging
No 'YOLO:' / 'Vision:' labels — Vision is the source of truth; YOLO confidence merged into a single 'confidence: 86%' if at all
Strip 'Mode:' / 'Reason:' / 'Thresholds:' debug-only fields from TG body (still in JSON for debugging)
MarkdownV2 (not plain Markdown): operator confirmed formatting matters, MarkdownV2 is the only mode that renders bold + emoji + headers correctly across TG clients

stories.title: Rewrite alert.py build_alert_message for Markdown + emoji + 4-6 line body
scope: Replace 8-line key:value dump with header line + class line + timestamp line + TG marker
Add TG X of 3 marker (parameter: tg_position, e.g. 'TG 1 of 3')
Return MarkdownV2-escaped body string (dispatcher.py owns the actual send; alert.py returns the body)
Shorten alert_id to first 8 chars in the body

stories.title: Rewrite detail.py build_detail_message to curated attribute list (no recursive dump)
scope: Walk the VM2 dict with a curated field list (clothing_upper, clothing_lower, hat, vehicle_make, vehicle_model, vehicle_color, posture, action) instead of recursive dump
Each attribute as '• Label: value' bullet, single line per attribute

stories.title: Rewrite match_alert.py: strip threshold debug lines, keep essentials
scope: Match body: only label / make / model / owner / score / gap. No 'Thresholds:' / 'Mode:' / 'Reason:' lines
No-match body: 'No match (confidence <threshold>)' single line + runner-ups (top 1 only) + TG X of 3 marker
Use Markdown formatting consistent with US-067a (✅ Match / ⚠️ Unsure)

stories.title: Enable parse_mode=MarkdownV2 in dispatcher + escape user data safely
scope: Escape reserved MarkdownV2 chars in dynamic strings (alert_id, camera name, owner name) — implement escape_markdown_v2(text) helper
TG X of 3 marker propagated via a dispatcher-side wrapper that knows the alert's tg_position
Verify with a dry-run script: send sample alert to a test chat (or print to stdout) and confirm emoji + bold render

non_goals: No TG-side polling / interaction (alerts are one-way)
Not touching the 2-bbox flow (V2-066 owns that)
